sources.config.json:
{
  "name": "Weather panel (JS)",
  "category": "data",
  "description": "Current conditions, an hourly chart or a daily list from Open-Meteo data. Wire weather from the Weather app and icons from the Weather icon set app.",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "fields": [
    { "name": "weather", "label": "Weather data (from Weather app)", "type": "json", "required": true },
    { "name": "icons", "label": "Icon set (from Weather icon set app)", "type": "json", "required": true },
    {
      "name": "mode",
      "label": "Mode",
      "type": "select",
      "options": ["current", "hourly", "daily"],
      "value": "current"
    },
    {
      "name": "hours",
      "label": "Hours to show",
      "type": "integer",
      "value": "10",
      "showIf": [{ "field": "mode", "operator": "eq", "value": "hourly" }]
    },
    {
      "name": "days",
      "label": "Days to show",
      "type": "integer",
      "value": "7",
      "showIf": [{ "field": "mode", "operator": "eq", "value": "daily" }]
    },
    {
      "name": "showValues",
      "label": "Show icons and temperatures (hourly)",
      "type": "boolean",
      "value": "true",
      "showIf": [{ "field": "mode", "operator": "eq", "value": "hourly" }]
    },
    {
      "name": "showGraph",
      "label": "Show graph (hourly)",
      "type": "boolean",
      "value": "true",
      "showIf": [{ "field": "mode", "operator": "eq", "value": "hourly" }]
    },
    { "name": "lowContrast", "label": "Low contrast", "type": "boolean", "value": "false" },
    { "name": "showLocation", "label": "Show location header", "type": "boolean", "value": "true" },
    {
      "name": "showDetails",
      "label": "Show detail row",
      "type": "boolean",
      "value": "true",
      "showIf": [{ "field": "mode", "operator": "eq", "value": "current" }]
    },
    { "name": "width", "label": "Width (0 = fit canvas)", "type": "integer", "value": "0" },
    { "name": "height", "label": "Height (0 = fit canvas)", "type": "integer", "value": "0" }
  ],
  "output": [{ "name": "image", "type": "image" }]
}

weather.name: Weather (Open-Meteo)
weather.description: Current, hourly and daily forecasts from Open-Meteo for a location.
